Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
"CthuluKitty" <vtana...@riseup.net> wrote in message
news:6c1c89ca.0409...@posting.google.com...
> > > Does Afifa愀 special work while she is in Torpor?

> > > Just to make sure ...
> >
> >
> > All vampires' specials work from torpor by default, still, yes.
>
> Really? I didn't think that was the case, but ok...so if for another
> example Bartholemew is in torpor and untapped at the start of my turn,
> do I gain a pool?

Yep.

Compare to Anson's text: "If Anson is ready, you get 2 master phase
actions (instead of 1) <during your master phase>." Note that Anson's
text explicitly says it only works if he's ready. Bartholomew's text,
on the other hand, is "If Bartholomew is untapped at the beginning of
your turn, you gain 1 pool from the blood bank." No mention of him
being required to be ready, so that ability works even if he's in
torpor.

Josh
